name: Granite Speech 5.0 2B
purpose: Compact speech-language model for multilingual ASR and bidirectional speech translation (card).

license.name: Apache-2.0
license.notes: Card metadata: apache-2.0; no LICENSE file in the repo. Canonical Apache-2.0 text read in the Qwen repo (canonical Apache-2.0 text read in https://github.com/QwenLM/Qwen3-ASR/blob/main/LICENSE).

architecture.kind: AUTOREGRESSIVE: 16-block Conformer CTC encoder + window Q-Former projector (10 Hz) + granite-4.0-1b-base LLM

engine_support.notes: Official GGUF; llama.cpp listed on the card

strengths: Official GGUF and broad runtime list incl. llama.cpp
granite-speech-4.1-2b-plus adds speaker labels and word timing (per the 4.1 NAR card)
weaknesses: Segments of about 2 min; split longer audio with VAD
No German WER in text; no diarization or timestamps on the 5.0 card
soft.maturity: IBM; 10+ speech repos updated in Oct-Nov 2026.

user_reports.summary: User measured about 12-17x realtime on long-form audio on V100/RTX 3060, decode-bound.

tona_fit.reason: Apache-2.0, 2B on a 1B Granite LLM, fits every class, official llama.cpp GGUF path and English leaderboard 6.68 (rank 21 of 69), German coverage official; but no German row on the independent leaderboard and the vendor German WER chart is an image. Missing Tona support is only a blocker.

open_questions: German WER of 5.0-2b is not on the multilingual leaderboard (only 4.1-2b-nar, 4 sets, 4.32); check the card image or run CommonVoice-DE ourselves

benchmarks.name: Open ASR English avg WER (leaderboard rank 21 of 69)
benchmarks.harness: Open ASR Leaderboard English track, read 2026-11-19

benchmarks.name: RTFx on the leaderboard (English track, leaderboard GPU)
CommonVoice German punctuation error rate / Cap-F1 (capitalization of nouns)
